message.content: The Yellow Submarine album (1969) was the first to include "It's All Too Much"; the song "Yellow Submarine" had already appeared on Revolver, and the other two songs are earlier Beatles tracks.
message.reasoning_content: Yellow Submarine album first included "It's All Too Much" and "Yellow Submarine" (song was on Revolver actually). "Yellow Submarine" song was on Revolver first. So first-appearance on Yellow Submarine album: "It's All Too Much".
